budget_protocol: Each numeric gpu_s budget is an independent per-arm deadline for one complete fixed-work ensemble; execute all budgets without early selection. Nine complete timing pairs per method per budget; one GPU per arm. Warmups separately charged, not included in per-arm deadline. Timeout, missing seed, changed work or invalid output fails that cell; do not condition on completed runs or infer an energy outcome from partial work.

confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds, no asymptotic or bootstrap substitution. For nine timing pairs, one-sided 95% median speedup lower bound is second-smallest baseline/method wall-time ratio (binomial lower tail P[Bin(9,0.5)<=1]=10/512). Require bound > 1.05. For eight seeds and two metrics, Bonferroni two-sided per-metric confidence 0.975, tails 0.0125: use [minimum,maximum] paired difference, whose noncoverage is 2/256 <= 0.025. Require each entire interval strictly inside [-abs_margin,+abs_margin]. Overall equivalence alpha = 1-0.95 = 0.05. Lack of significance never establishes equivalence. Apply rules separately to every method and budget; overall success requires all declared cells pass, no best-budget or best-method selection claim.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work molecular dynamics benchmark has no calibrated scalar outcome curve or threshold target. Complete exactly eight 25000-step replicas with unchanged physics and pass both statistical energy-equivalence tests; do not reduce scientific work.

evidence_limits: Raw energy series are not persisted by the baseline driver. This seal tests recorded mean and final potential energy only; it does not establish the brief full-series identity claim. No exact or bitwise requirement is imposed on stochastic trajectories.

Across-seed standard errors are measured baseline-derived margins permitted by this protocol; they are not measurements of same-seed run-to-run variability or published scientific acceptance thresholds.

Published approximate 5000 ns/day anchor is contextual only. results/reproduce/anchors_scored.json reports 1115.35727680178 ns/day, with no tolerance or uncertainty; no acceptance margin is derived from that reference.
No method outputs or calibrated scientific outcome curves are available. No unconditional powered-equivalence guarantee is supported by present evidence.
No gate script is named by the prompt or intake; intake/benchmark.json records gate_scripts=null. No workloads, builds, method code or external source lookups are part of this seal.

hardware_cost_basis.description: One NVIDIA A10, driver 570.148.08 as measured in results/reproduce/out/probe.json. GPU seconds = complete synchronized reported ensemble wall seconds times one allocated GPU, including host intervals and idle time. MPS workers share this GPU; do not charge each process as a separate GPU. Compare identical hardware/software and reserve GPU exclusively between arms.

infeasible_methods.reason: Only one GPU. Equal GPU-second cost Amdahl/k bound = 1 < 1.05; infeasible.
Transfer fraction p=0.0020825346475383077 with k=2 gives Amdahl ceiling 1.0010423526915666 < 1.05, before launch/synchronization overhead.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair baseline and method by input identity and exact replica seed; seed controls velocity initialization and Langevin integrator stream. For each metric use method minus baseline per-seed summaries from the first scheduled complete timing pair at each budget, fixed before outcomes are seen. Timing repeats do not increase independent scientific sample size. All eight seeds must complete. Fixed seeds do not make Langevin sampling nonstochastic.

power.assumptions: Conditional planning only: independent seeded pairs and each paired difference within both sealed margins with probability at least 0.99. With n=8 the finite Bonferroni median intervals use minimum and maximum; all-eight containment probability is at least 0.99^8 = 0.9227446944279201 under this assumption. Paired-difference variability is not measured; empirical power and unconditional 90% power cannot be claimed. No sample-size adaptation or seed replacement.

scheduling_protocol: For each method and budget, run nine adjacent baseline/method pairs. Use scheduling seed 20261029 to randomize arm order within each pair and method/budget block order before execution; no overlapping baseline and method arms. Same eight scientific seeds in every pair. Persist generated order and all failures; no rescheduling based on observed timing or energies.

splits.development: Permitted existing baseline and profile evidence only; no method outcomes observed before seal.
splits.held_out: Prospective baseline/method paired executions are held out. Input structure and seed identities are public fixed benchmark fixtures, not unseen structures or new random seeds. No training split or generalization claim.

timing_scope.description: Matching ensemble completion scope: timer begins before any replica context or concurrent-worker launch and ends after all eight replicas complete, energy reads synchronize, contexts/integrators are destroyed, transfers finish and results merge in replica order. Include launch, context creation, initialization, transfer, stepping, energy queries, synchronization, cleanup and merge overhead. Baseline total_wall_s scope from intake/EXECUTION.json; never substitute sum of replica wall_s. Imports, fixed PDB parsing, common System construction, installation and final JSON serialization outside timer for both arms.

warmup_protocol: Zero excluded warmup runs per arm. First-use context/kernel costs remain inside each timed ensemble; use the same initial cache policy for both arms, no selective precompilation.
